name: parse_ymd_dash_with_whitespace
spec: Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY.MM.DD (1- or 2-digit month / day). Surrounding / repeated whitespace is ignored.

name: parse_ymd_dot_single_digits
spec: Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY.MM.DD (1- or 2-digit month / day).

name: parse_us_slash_year_last_month_first
spec: Accepts US MM/DD/YYYY with "/" "-" or "." (1- or 2-digit month / day). A slash date with the year last is always read month first, never day first.

name: parse_us_dash_single_digits
spec: Accepts US MM/DD/YYYY with "/" "-" or "." (1- or 2-digit month / day).

name: parse_month_name_day_first
spec: Accepts "June 14, 2027", "Jun 14 2027", "Jun. 14, 2027" and "14 June 2027" (month names, any case, first 3 letters count).

name: parse_month_name_abbrev_with_dot
spec: Accepts "June 14, 2027", "Jun 14 2027", "Jun. 14, 2027" and "14 June 2027" (month names, any case, first 3 letters count).

name: parse_impossible_day_returns_none
spec: Anything else (empty, "ASAP", "Summer 2027", 2-digit years, impossible dates such as 02/30/2027 or 13/01/2027) → None.

name: parse_season_text_returns_none
spec: Anything else (empty, "ASAP", "Summer 2027", 2-digit years, impossible dates such as 02/30/2027 or 13/01/2027) → None.

name: to_mask_syntiant_year_first
spec: YYYY → 4-digit year, YY → last 2 digits, MM / DD → zero-padded 2 digits, M / D → no padding. The output keeps the mask's token order and separator exactly, and nothing else.

name: to_mask_month_name_value_dmy_mask
spec: to_mask(value, placeholder) → the value written in the box's own format, or None when value is not a date (parse_date None). The output keeps the mask's token order and separator exactly, and nothing else.

name: to_mask_unpadded_month_day
spec: YYYY → 4-digit year, YY → last 2 digits, MM / DD → zero-padded 2 digits, M / D → no padding.

name: to_mask_two_digit_year_dot_mask
spec: YYYY → 4-digit year, YY → last 2 digits, MM / DD → zero-padded 2 digits, M / D → no padding. The output keeps the mask's token order and separator exactly, and nothing else.

name: to_mask_placeholder_with_surrounding_text
spec: Text around the mask in the placeholder is ignored ("Date (YYYY-MM-DD)" → mask "YYYY-MM-DD").

name: to_mask_spaced_separator_preserved
spec: The mask is the first part of the placeholder made of three tokens, one each of year (YYYY or YY), month (MM or M) and day (DD or D), any letter case, joined by the same separator (any non-alphanumeric run, e.g. "/", "-", ".", " / "). The output keeps the mask's token order and separator exactly, and nothing else.

name: to_mask_no_placeholder_falls_back
spec: No placeholder, an empty one, or one with no such mask (e.g. "Select a date", or two different separators, or a token repeated such as "MM/MM/YYYY") → Workable's own "YYYY/MM/DD".

name: to_mask_placeholder_without_mask_falls_back
spec: No placeholder, an empty one, or one with no such mask (e.g. "Select a date", or two different separators, or a token repeated such as "MM/MM/YYYY") → Workable's own "YYYY/MM/DD".

name: to_mask_empty_placeholder_falls_back
spec: No placeholder, an empty one, or one with no such mask (e.g. "Select a date", or two different separators, or a token repeated such as "MM/MM/YYYY") → Workable's own "YYYY/MM/DD".

name: to_mask_two_different_separators_falls_back
spec: No placeholder, an empty one, or one with no such mask (e.g. "Select a date", or two different separators, or a token repeated such as "MM/MM/YYYY") → Workable's own "YYYY/MM/DD".

name: to_mask_repeated_token_falls_back
spec: No placeholder, an empty one, or one with no such mask (e.g. "Select a date", or two different separators, or a token repeated such as "MM/MM/YYYY") → Workable's own "YYYY/MM/DD".

name: to_mask_non_date_value_returns_none
spec: to_mask(value, placeholder) → the value written in the box's own format, or None when value is not a date (parse_date None).

name: same_date_equal_across_formats
spec: same_date(want, got) → True only when both parse (parse_date) to the same (year, month, day); False if either is None.

name: same_date_different_day_false
spec: same_date(want, got) → True only when both parse (parse_date) to the same (year, month, day); False if either is None.

name: same_date_got_unparseable_false
spec: same_date(want, got) → True only when both parse (parse_date) to the same (year, month, day); False if either is None.

name: same_date_day_last_slash_read_month_first_false
spec: A slash date with the year last is always read month first, never day first. same_date(want, got) → True only when both parse (parse_date) to the same (year, month, day); False if either is None.

name: same_date_both_month_names_true
spec: Accepts "June 14, 2027", "Jun 14 2027", "Jun. 14, 2027" and "14 June 2027" (month names, any case, first 3 letters count). same_date(want, got) → True only when both parse (parse_date) to the same (year, month, day).
